description:
Searches what changed in this project's dependencies since your training data, for the versions it has installed: removed, renamed and moved APIs, options and config keys, new required arguments, changed defaults and behavior, file conventions. Sources are the installed versions' type declarations, every release-note item since your training data and the packages' upgrade guides; each result says which.

Call it BEFORE your first edit whenever the task touches a library's API or a config file, even for libraries you know well and even when you're sure: your training data predates these versions, and the API you remember may be gone. Also call it when a type error or warning names a package's API.

Describe what you are about to do in your own words; old names are fine and often best. Good: 'resolve alias for a module in next.config', 'middleware that redirects with cookies', 'zod error message per parse', 'tsconfig baseUrl paths aliases', 'mongoose pre save hook next'. Bad (too vague): 'config', 'errors'. Keep one topic per call; call again for another. Do not call it more than 4 times for one question.

cutoff.description: Training cutoff (YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD) to use instead of a model id.

cwd.description: Project directory containing package.json (default: the server's working directory)

model.description: Your own model id (e.g. claude-opus-5-5). Defaults to the model configured in the coding agent's settings.

package.description: Limit to one npm package of this project, e.g. `next`, `zod`, `typescript` (default: all of them)

query.description: What you're about to do or look up, in your own words: an API, option, config key, file or error message. Old names are fine.

name: search_changes
title: Search what changed in this project's dependencies
